title: "Documentation for individual apps"

## Links and info

All apps have a uniform header or menu line with a link to the `hmt-apps` home page on the left, and on the right, a version identifier for the specific app plus a link to documentation for the specific app. Immediately below this header line is the title of the app. 

Here is an example showing the header line for the *Venetus A facsimile* app, in version `0.3.0`.

> ![Example of a uniform header line (from the Venetus A facsimile app, version 0.3.0)](./menu.png)

## Citable connections across HMT data

Throughout the HMT archive, texts are related to physical artifacts documented by citable images. All apps for browsing texts, manuscript pages or images can be bookmarked by a URN for manuscript page (`page`), textual passage (`text`) or image (`image`).


## Text formatting and navigation

All textual displays organize the display of passages by physical page, and support previous/next navigation.
